draft.title: Mars square Lilith
draft.humanMoment: A landlord removes a long-standing memorial from a shared courtyard, and residents put it back before the trash has been collected.
draft.developmentDetail: Each new removal brings louder protests, damaged locks, and anger far larger than the original cleanup dispute.
draft.planetaryDynamic: Mars carries the landlord's sanctioned effort to control the property, while Lilith carries the residents' banished rage and refusal to let the memorial be tamed into compliance.
draft.aspectMechanic: The square forces the courtyard into the same cycle of removal, protest, and reinstallation until the fight over who controls the space is addressed.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If both sides keep repeating their claim through the memorial, access to the courtyard may be restricted while the underlying dispute remains untouched.

judge.weakest: Mars carries the landlord's sanctioned effort to control the property, while Lilith carries the residents' banished rage and refusal to let the memorial be tamed into compliance.
judge.why: The dynamic is accurate and specific, though the phrase about taming the memorial is slightly less natural than the surrounding copy. All required field functions and aspect mechanics are present.
